summary: First-finish smoke pass for UAT Text Comparator. Backend endpoints (/api/, /api/glossary GET+POST, /api/compare happy path + missing-field 422 + unsupported .txt 400, /api/export/pdf, /api/batch matched+unmatched, /api/export/csv) all behave correctly. Frontend navigation, Compare flow (upload docx+eml -> diff report with all sections -> PDF download), Glossary flow (add/save/remove/save), and Batch flow (4 files -> 2 rows -> CSV download) all work end-to-end via public URL. Glossary was restored to original after tests.
passed: POST /api/glossary saves new rule and GET reflects it; restored to originals
POST /api/compare (docx+eml) -> full report: subject/greeting/cta/footer/body/links/images + summary(score_percent=77.8, match=7, warning=0, mismatch=2, overall=mismatch)
POST /api/compare with foo.txt -> 400 'Unsupported output file type'
POST /api/batch with ZIP (2 pairs) -> reports=2, csv_rows=2, unmatched empty
Compare page: diff-report shows summary-score/match/warning/mismatch and diff-subject/greeting/cta/footer/body-0/link-0/image-0; export-pdf-btn downloads uat_report.pdf
Glossary page: add-rule-btn adds row (2->3), fill+save-glossary-btn succeeds, remove+save restores
Batch page: uploading 4 files runs batch, batch-results table with 2 rows, export-csv-btn downloads uat_batch_summary.csv

failed.issue: Sonner success toast overlays the export-pdf-btn briefly after run-compare succeeds; a normal click within ~4s is intercepted by the toast element (subtree intercepts pointer events). Works after toast auto-dismisses (~5s) or with force=true.
failed.evidence: Playwright click on [data-testid=export-pdf-btn] timed out with 'toast group-[.toaster] ... subtree intercepts pointer events'. Retry after 5s wait + force=true succeeded and downloaded uat_report.pdf.

action_items: Optional UX polish: shorten the 'compare succeeded' toast duration, or ensure the toaster container has pointer-events:none on non-interactive area so it never intercepts clicks on primary action buttons like Export PDF.
